owner_feedback.text: The lamp shade in the top-down view is nice but should include a lighting effect with a soft glow affecting items in a radius.  What other elements can we add or improve in the Wide composition?  You can launch another Haiku subagent to look into the story beats for the metagame for ideas, but I think also we could use some more "standard" items: refrigerator, stove, countertop, TV, floor lamp, art on wall.  Probably a toy shelf with a few other kinds of toys.  We may later develop other apartment views such that this one doesn't get so crowded, and compose them such that the duck is in those too.  The metagame has several dialogue beats that could show the duck in a variety of apartment locations.  I authorize a further scope expansion of preview.html to at least two other apartment views.

Shadow from top-down pencil should be closer to pencil, at this distance it looks like it's floating in the air.  Top-down duck looks good as do keys and paper.  Are those coins at the bottom?  Those could be improved with some quasi-visual designs to provide the impression of detail without compromising the other elements' simplicity.  Lamp glow looks really nice.  Sticky note has the same shadow distance issue: it probably shouldn't have a shadow at all, if it's stuck to the paper.  Let's move the head of the lamp closer to the top left (shorten the visible length of the lamp neck).

cases.title: Living-room lamp spreads equally; couch pillow floats; desk-side mug too big; desk-side light direction does not match the lamp
cases.context_before_feedback: Committed state 5e24816 (20:09:54 local) with the new living room, kitchen, bedroom + toy shelf and the two desk views. No assistant edits to preview.html occurred between that commit and the owner message at 20:23:30 local (the transcript shows adjacent records).

owner_feedback.text: In the living room, the warm lamp light seems to radiate in all directions equally - more of it should affect objects below it and directly above (the effect of the lampshade).  The pillow on the couch should be lowered to make contact with the seat cushion.  Decrease the size of the coffee cup in the desk side view.  Also in that view, make the light a bit more diffuse though I do like how it's more directed in that view - but, the direction doesn't align with the orientation of the lamp.

cases.what_changed_afterward: Commit 7ad98f1 (20:25:41 local): living-room, kitchen and bedroom lamps made directional (mostly downward with a fainter upward spill and a small halo at the shade), couch pillow lowered onto the seat cushion, desk side-view mug scaled to 72%, desk side-view lamp head tilted so its opening faces down and slightly right with two soft blurred cones and a diffuse pool. Diff: evidence/diff-lamp-pillow-mug-5e24816-to-7ad98f1.patch. My account is at line 1560 (my words).
cases.owner_response: No explicit reply. M7 (toy shelf) followed and did not mention these items.
classification: experience/consistency issue (light radiating equally from a shaded lamp contradicts how a lampshade directs light)
visible defect (pillow not in contact with the seat cushion)
visible defect / proportion (mug too large in the desk side view)
consistency defect plus aesthetic preference (light direction not aligned with the lamp orientation; more diffuse but "I do like how it's more directed")
cases.reviewer_knowability: Pillow contact and light direction versus lamp orientation are checkable in the image. Mug size is a proportion judgement. The preference for a directed-but-more-diffuse light is the owner's and not inferable.

known_limitations: I did not recheck neutral/window light, other framings or phone width after this change (line 1560).
Commit-to-message linkage is by git time and my transcript, not owner confirmation.
